chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn and Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū Ḥamzah al-Thumālī, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
When Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم had completed his prophethood and fulfilled his days, Allāh, the Exalted, revealed to him:

"O Muḥammad, you have completed your prophethood and fulfilled your days; so place the knowledge that is with you, and the faith, and the Greatest Name, and the inheritance of knowledge, and the traces of the knowledge of prophethood among your Ahl al-Bayt with ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib. For I shall never cut off the knowledge, the faith, the Greatest Name, the inheritance of knowledge, and the traces of the knowledge of prophethood from the descendants among your offspring, just as I did not cut them off from the offspring of the Prophets."

key_terms.آثَارَ عِلْمِ النُّبُوَّةِ: the traces or transmitted remnants of the knowledge of prophethood
key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِكَ: your Household; the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الِاسْمَ الْأَكْبَرَ: the Greatest Name; a supreme divine designation associated with special sacred authority
key_terms.الْإِيمَانَ: faith; here, a divinely guarded reality transmitted with sacred trust
key_terms.الْعِلْمَ: the divinely entrusted knowledge preserved after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.ذُرِّيَّتِكَ: your progeny; the descendants through whom this trust continues
key_terms.مِيرَاثَ الْعِلْمِ: the inheritance of knowledge; what is passed on from prophetic knowledge
key_terms.نُبُوَّتَكَ: your prophethood; the prophetic mission granted by Allāh

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the transfer of prophetic knowledge and authority to ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when the mission of the Prophet Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم reached completion, Allāh commanded that the divinely entrusted knowledge, faith, the Greatest Name, and the inheritance of prophetic knowledge be placed with ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام among the Ahl al-Bayt. It presents the continuation of divine guidance through the Prophet’s progeny as consistent with the pattern established among earlier Prophets.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn and Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
When the Prophet-hood of Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> expired and his<sup>saww</sup> days were completed, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted Revealed unto him<sup>saww</sup>: “

O Muhammadsaww! Yoursaww Prophet-hood has expired and yoursaww days are completed, therefore make the Knowledge which is with yousaww, and the Eman, and the Great Name, and inheritance of the Knowledge, and the traces (Ahadeeth) of Knowledge of the Prophet-hood to be in the Peopleasws of yoursaww Household with Aliasws Bin Abu Talibasws, for Iazwj Never Cut-off the Knowledge, and the Eman, and the Great Name, and inheritance of the Knowledge, and traces of the Knowledge (Ahadeeth) of the Prophet-hood, from the descendants of yoursaww offspring, just as Iazwj did not Cut it off from the offspring of the Prophetsas (before)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Fudayl from abu Hamza al-Thumali who has said that he heard abu Ja‘far (a.s.) say the following.
“When Muhammad (s.a.) completed his task of prophet-hood and the duration of his life was about to end Allah, the Most High sent him wahy information through the angels.
It said, “O Muhammad, your task of prophet-hood has come to an end and the duration of your life is about to reach a close.

Therefore, you must place the knowledge with you, the faith, the great name, the legacy of knowledge and the symbols of the knowledge of the prophet-hood in your family with Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.). It is because I do not want to discontinue the knowledge, the faith, the great name, the legacy of the of knowledge and the symbols of knowledge of the prophet-hood from your posterior descendents as I had not done so with descendents of the prophets.”
